svg.title: Native patch encoding, persistent feature rows and separate graph fitting
svg.desc: Python exports the fixed panel-specific TorchScript encoder once. QuPath reads the selected image patch and runs the retained DJL/LibTorch encoder, receiving one 768-value vector. Completed float32 rows and their checksums belong to a persistent N by 768 patch table outside either process boundary. Python maps selected completed rows and constructs the required self/neighbour training arrays for spatial fitting. Fitted graph weights return to native execution, which reuses completed feature rows, applies the frozen mean/self transform and native RF/SVM, and produces patch predictions. Temporary Python training arrays are not depicted as shared storage. Planes, matrix entries, patch IDs and predictions are schematic.
